icons.name: 子彈時間
icons.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: one minimal white game HUD ability icon, Bullet Time, transparent PNG.
Reference image 1 is the USER'S COMPOSITION SKETCH and is the highest priority for subject arrangement. Reference image 2 is the previous white icon, only a reference for visual weight and white-on-transparent styling; replace its composition.
Create a pair of simple sharp focused eyes spread to the left and right, with a clearly recognizable SMOKING PISTOL FRONT BARREL / SLIDE NOSE rising into the gap between them from the lower center, as in the sketch. This is a compact graphic emblem, not a drawing of a scene.
Eyes: narrow, severe, angular upper eyelids/brows with pointed inner corners and two simple dark/transparent pupils. Two separate eyes, symmetrical overall, looking directly forward. Keep a generous empty gap between their inner corners for the muzzle smoke.
Pistol: ONLY the cropped front third of a squared semiautomatic pistol slide and barrel, viewed at a slight three-quarter perspective like the sketch. It comes up from the lower center/right and leans slightly toward upper left, muzzle just below the midpoint between the eyes. Include one large unmistakable transparent circular bore opening on its small angled front muzzle face and one simple blocky white slide body. No grip, no trigger, no hand, no whole pistol. Avoid the look of a cigarette, chimney, drinking glass or suppressor cylinder.
Smoke: two short bold smoothly tapered curling wisps visibly originate at the muzzle bore and rise through the middle space between the eyes, finishing above eye height. Smoke is a simplified clean WHITE GRAPHIC shape, not realistic mist, clouds, flames or muzzle flash. Keep smoke distinct from the eyes.
Composition: square canvas, entire emblem centered with at least 10 percent transparent outer margins. Eyes form the middle horizontal band, short pistol nose occupies lower central area, smoke fills upper center, matching the user's sketch. No full head or face outline, no nose or mouth.
Style: very simple bold white FPS ability pictogram, original Overwatch-style visual language, flat vector-like white solid shapes, large fully transparent negative spaces, balanced robust geometry legible at 64px. Minimal amount of detail. Preserve actual transparent background and cutouts. Absolutely no gray paint, black filled backdrop, texture, speckles, debris, distress, pencil contours, shadows, gradients, text, letters, numbers, framing, clock or badges. All shapes must have clean antialiased edges and clean empty transparent spaces.

Refinement:
Refine this exact white transparent game ability icon. Preserve the current pair of sharp eyes, their expressions and positions, the tilted handgun-front composition, and the two upward curling smoke wisps. Make ONE targeted correction to the pistol: it must have ONLY ONE muzzle bore, on its upper angled end face where smoke currently emerges. REMOVE the second large circular hole currently on the vertical front-facing body immediately beneath the angled end face. That whole vertical body panel should become a clean uninterrupted solid white slide silhouette, without a hole. The single remaining muzzle opening at the top should be a clean transparent oval and both wisps clearly originate at that SAME opening. Keep the weapon cropped to the front slide/barrel segment only; no whole gun, hands or grip. Uniform white monochrome, genuinely transparent empty background, transparent cutouts, simple solid bold shapes. Remove stray grunge flecks and hairline sketch residue where possible without changing the design. Scale the complete composition slightly smaller inside the square canvas to leave 8 percent empty transparent margins on every outer edge; the barrel ends naturally inside the canvas, not on the canvas edge. No other changes, no text.
